('# CONTRACT
## Resource targets
- [ ] **Advisory goal:** Seek fewer routed Slice LUTs than the baseline of 55 on `xc7a35tcpg236-1`; record the routed count and whether it is below 55, even if the experiment finds no reduction.

## Timing targets
- [ ] The routed timing report for the 10.0 ns clock shows setup slack (WNS) ≥ 0 ns and hold slack (WHS) ≥ 0 ns.

## Correctness
- [ ] Preserve the ports, parameter defaults, and synchronous reset behavior; pass the provided testbench’s cycle checks and report `TEST PASSED`.
- [ ] Static/interface checks and compilation pass using the fixed provided testbench, tools, device, and constraints, without modifying the harness.

## Code quality
- [ ] Synthesis of top module `counter` for `xc7a35tcpg236-1` completes without unresolved synthesis errors.

## Definition of done

All hard-gate checklist items pass with evidence from the fixed simulation and Vivado reports; report the routed LUT count as the advisory optimization result.', '- **Investigate — “Static/interface checks” is undefined.** The harness facts identify the top module and testbench, but do not specify which static or interface checks run or what evidence passes them. Rewrite to name the checks and pass evidence, or remove this as a separate gate.
- **Investigate — “Synthesis … completes without unresolved synthesis errors” is vague.** The retained script promotes three message IDs to errors, but the contract does not define “unresolved” or the completion evidence. Rewrite with the harness’s synthesis completion and error evidence as the pass condition.

The timing, simulation, and advisory LUT criteria are testable as written.', <autortl.budget.Budget object at 0x000001D3C24D3620>)
